subject: STABLE: TEGU_PERF_RT (per-attachment raw load/store/size) + gated DontCare loads (NORD2_METAL_DONTCARE=1); step plan with ms/cmd estimates
body: New: (a) nord2_render_pass.inc records Metal's own load/store per attachment; TEGU_PERF_RT line per window: rt0/rt1 load dontcare/load/clear, store dontcare/store/other, full-size count. Today DontCare loads are folded into Clear, so the c6l 'clear 548 vs load 190' cannot tell which. (b) NORD2_METAL_DONTCARE=1 (default off) keeps DontCare as load 0; n2r writes back all tiles only for Clear (clean_tile_write_enable==Clear; also lets INTERSECT stay on for DontCare targets); the first job of a DontCare target neither clears nor writes untouched tiles. Render oracle + bridge test PASS; run_host_tests 58 PASS; render harness, CA PF0/PF1, integration 1005 except the known CA stride check (inert pass test needed a guard, fixed). The final strict bundle link currently fails on 'undefined symbol tegu_air_render_pipeline_immutable_sampler' = texture agent's new Rust export not yet in the iOS archive (not mine). Estimates (c6l ui60, 350 MHz; per command: 13.3 jobs, 9.24 full-screen x ~1.8 ms ~16.6 ms GPU, present_us 29.6 ms): step A DontCare no-clear: 0-3 ms (depends on TEGU_PERF_RT: large if CA's always-cleared second attachment is really DontCare-load/DontCare-store). Step B one job per 2-attachment pass (MRT framebuffer for every draw, LD_TILE for any RT, 2-RT pre-frame preload; bridge+n2r mine, pass-MRT pipeline variant from encode-cpu-opus): FS jobs 9.2 -> ~2.1, GPU ~16.6 -> ~6-8 ms, CPU ~-5 ms (0.8 ms per kernel job outside the kernel) => ~14-17 ms/cmd. Step C pass merging (sibling passmerge: equal attachments, Load/DontCare, movable passes between): FS ~2.1 -> ~1.5, ~-1 ms. Step D AFBC for private full-size RTs (sibling: clear-only pass 0.8 -> 0.19 ms; needs texture agent's AFBC sampling + RT AFBC writeback in n2r): ~-1-2 ms. At 654 MHz the compute part scales ~x0.55. Sibling note: their biggest single win on CA was shader cost (fast-mode float deviations, 25.8 -> 8.9 ms GPU/frame in Mindustry) = compile path, not job structure.
